items.source: ContextClosedEvent handler for initiating an early shutdown.
items.translation: 用于启动提前关闭的 ContextClosedEvent 处理器。

items.source: Variant of setAwaitTerminationSeconds(int) with millisecond precision.
items.translation: 带有毫秒精度的 `setAwaitTerminationSeconds(int)` 变体。

items.source: This flag will only have effect when the executor is running in a Spring application context and able to receive the ContextClosedEvent. Also, note that ThreadPoolTaskExecutor effectively accepts tasks after context close by default, in combination with a coordinated lifecycle stop, unless "strictEarlyShutdown" has been specified.
items.translation: 此标志仅在执行器在 Spring 应用程序上下文中运行且能够接收 ContextClosedEvent 时生效。此外，请注意，除非已指定 "strictEarlyShutdown"，否则 ThreadPoolTaskExecutor 默认会在与协调的生命周期停止相结合后接受上下文关闭后的任务。

items.source: Called from onApplicationEvent(ContextClosedEvent) if no indications for a late shutdown have been determined, that is, if the "acceptTasksAfterContextClose and "waitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown" flags have not been set.
items.translation: 由 onApplicationEvent(ContextClosedEvent) 调用，前提是未检测到延迟关闭的迹象，即如果尚未设置 "acceptTasksAfterContextClose" 和 "waitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown" 标志。

items.source: This is different from the default phase Integer.MAX_VALUE associated with other SmartLifecycle implementations, putting the typically auto-started executor/scheduler beans into an earlier startup phase and a later shutdown phase while still leaving room for regular Lifecycle components with the common phase 0.
items.translation: 这与与其他SmartLifecycle实现关联的默认阶段Integer.MAX_VALUE不同，它将通常自动启动的执行器/调度器 Bean 置于更早的启动阶段和更晚的关闭阶段，同时仍为具有通用阶段 0 的常规Lifecycle组件留出空间。

items.source: acceptTasksAfterContextClose=true like behavior also follows from "waitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown" which effectively is a specific variant of this flag, replacing the early soft shutdown in the concurrent managed stop phase with a serial soft shutdown in the executor's destruction step, with individual awaiting according to the "awaitTerminationSeconds" property.
items.translation: `acceptTasksAfterContextClose=true` 的行为同样适用于 "waitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown"， 该选项实际上是此标志的一个特定变体：它将并发管理停止阶段中的早期软关闭替换为执行器销毁步骤中的串行软关闭，并根据 "awaitTerminationSeconds" 属性对各个任务进行等待。

items.source: In a Jakarta EE or other managed environment with JSR-236 support, consider specifying a JNDI-located ManagedThreadFactory: by default, to be found at "java:comp/DefaultManagedThreadFactory". Use the "jee:jndi-lookup" namespace element in XML or the programmatic JndiLocatorDelegate for convenient lookup. Alternatively, consider using Spring's DefaultManagedAwareThreadFactory with its fallback to local threads in case of no managed thread factory found.
items.translation: 在支持 JSR-236 的 Jakarta EE 或其他托管环境中，可以考虑指定一个位于 JNDI 的 ManagedThreadFactory：默认情况下，该工厂位于 "java:comp/DefaultManagedThreadFactory"。请在 XML 中使用 "jee:jndi-lookup" 命名空间元素，或使用程序化的 JndiLocatorDelegate 进行便捷的查找。或者，可以考虑使用 Spring 的 DefaultManagedAwareThreadFactory，并在未找到托管线程工厂时回退到本地线程。

items.source: The default is false, with a coordinated lifecycle stop first (unless "acceptTasksAfterContextClose" has been set) and then an immediate shutdown through interrupting ongoing tasks and clearing the queue. Switch this flag to true if you prefer fully completed tasks at the expense of a longer shutdown phase. The executor will not go through a coordinated lifecycle stop phase then but rather only stop and wait for task completion on its own shutdown.
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`，首先执行协调的生命周期停止（除非已设置"acceptTasksAfterContextClose"），然后通过中断正在运行的任务并清空队列立即关闭。如果您更倾向于完全完成的任务，即使这会延长关闭阶段，请将此标志切换为 `true`。执行器将不会经过协调的生命周期停止阶段，而是在其自身关闭时仅停止并等待任务完成。

items.source: The default for executors/schedulers is DEFAULT_PHASE as of 6.2, for stopping after other SmartLifecycle implementations.
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，执行器/调度器的默认值为DEFAULT_PHASE，用于在其他SmartLifecycle实现之后停止。

items.source: Set this flag to true on Java 21 or higher for a tightly managed thread pool setup with virtual threads. In contrast to SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor, this is integrated with Spring's lifecycle management for stopping and restarting execution threads, including an early stop signal for a graceful shutdown arrangement.
items.translation: 将此标志设置为 Java 21 或更高版本的 true，以配置带有虚拟线程的紧密管理线程池。与SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor相比，此功能集成了 Spring 的生命周期管理，用于停止和重新启动执行线程，包括为优雅关闭安排提供的早期停止信号。

items.source: By default, this executor won't wait for the termination of tasks at all. It will either shut down immediately, interrupting ongoing tasks and clearing the remaining task queue - or, if the "waitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown" flag has been set to true, it will continue to fully execute all ongoing tasks as well as all remaining tasks in the queue, in parallel to the rest of the container shutting down.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此执行器根本不会等待任务终止。它要么立即关闭，中断正在运行的任务并清空剩余的任务队列；或者，如果已设置"waitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown"标志为true，则将继续完全执行所有正在运行的任务以及队列中的所有剩余任务，同时容器其余部分也在关闭。

items.source: Defines common configuration settings and common lifecycle handling, inheriting thread customization options (name, priority, etc) from CustomizableThreadCreator.
items.translation: 定义通用配置设置和通用生命周期处理，从 CustomizableThreadCreator 继承线程自定义选项（名称、优先级等）。

items.source: Specify either this or setThreadFactory(ThreadFactory), not both.
items.translation: 指定此选项或setThreadFactory(ThreadFactory)，不可两者兼用。

items.source: The default is false as of 6.1, triggering an early soft shutdown of the executor and therefore rejecting any further task submissions. Switch this to true in order to let other components submit tasks even during their own stop and destruction callbacks, at the expense of a longer shutdown phase. The executor will not go through a coordinated lifecycle stop phase then but rather only stop tasks on its own shutdown.
items.translation: 默认值自 6.1 版本起为 `false`，这会触发执行器的早期软关闭，从而拒绝任何后续的任务提交。将其切换为 `true` 以允许其他组件在其自身的停止和销毁回调期间提交任务，但这会延长关闭阶段。此时，执行器将不会经历协调的生命周期停止阶段，而仅在其自身关闭时停止任务。

items.source: Note that Spring's container shutdown continues while ongoing tasks are being completed. If you want this executor to block and wait for the termination of tasks before the rest of the container continues to shut down - for example, in order to keep up other resources that your tasks may need -, set the "awaitTerminationSeconds" property instead of or in addition to this property.
items.translation: 请注意，Spring 容器的关闭过程会在持续的任务完成时继续进行。如果您希望该执行器阻塞并等待任务终止后再继续关闭容器中的其余部分——例如，为了保留您的任务可能需要使用的其他资源——请设置 "awaitTerminationSeconds" 属性，而不是或除了此属性之外。

items.source: The executor will not accept further tasks and will prevent further scheduling of periodic tasks, letting existing tasks complete still. This step is non-blocking and can be applied as an early shutdown signal before following up with a full shutdown() call later on.
items.translation: 执行器将不再接受新任务，并阻止进一步调度周期性任务，但允许现有任务继续完成。此步骤是非阻塞的，可作为早期关闭信号应用，随后再调用完整的 shutdown() 方法。

items.source: Automatically called for early shutdown signals on context close. Can be manually called as well, in particular outside a container.
items.translation: 在接收到早期关闭信号时自动调用，例如在context close(org.springframework.context.event.ContextClosedEvent)上。也可以手动调用，特别是在容器外部。

items.source: This step potentially blocks for the configured termination period, waiting for remaining tasks to complete. For an early shutdown signal to not accept further tasks, call initiateShutdown() first.
items.translation: 此步骤可能会在配置的终止期内阻塞，等待剩余任务完成。若要使提前关闭信号不再接受新任务，请首先调用initiateShutdown()。

items.source: The default implementation calls initiateShutdown().
items.translation: 默认实现调用initiateShutdown()。

items.source: In either case, if you specify an await-termination period using this property, this executor will wait for the given time (max) for the termination of tasks. As a rule of thumb, specify a significantly higher timeout here if you set "waitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown" to true at the same time, since all remaining tasks in the queue will still get executed - in contrast to the default shutdown behavior where it's just about waiting for currently executing tasks that aren't reacting to thread interruption.
items.translation: 在任何一种情况下，如果通过此属性指定了等待终止时间，该执行器将等待给定的时间（最大）以完成任务的终止。一般来说，如果您同时将 `waitForTasksToCompleteOnShutdown` 设置为 `true`，请在此处指定一个显著更高的超时时间，因为队列中的所有剩余任务仍将继续执行——这与默认的关闭行为不同，后者仅涉及等待那些未对线程中断做出反应的当前正在执行的任务。

items.source: The default phase for an executor SmartLifecycle: Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2.
items.translation: 执行器 `SmartLifecycle` 的默认阶段：Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2。

items.translation: 取消由 ExecutorService.shutdownNow() 返回且从未开始执行的给定剩余任务。

items.source: Early shutdown signal: do not trigger further tasks, let existing tasks complete before hitting the actual destruction step in the shutdown() method.
items.translation: 早期关闭信号：不要触发更多任务，让现有任务在到达shutdown()方法中的实际销毁步骤之前完成。

items.source: Calls initialize() after the container applied all property values.
items.translation: 在容器应用所有属性值后调用initialize()。

items.source: Calls shutdown when the BeanFactory destroys the executor instance.
items.translation: 销毁执行器实例时，BeanFactory 会调用shutdown。

items.source:
An after-execute callback for framework subclasses to delegate to
(for start/stop handling), and possibly also for custom subclasses
to extend (making sure to call this implementation as well).
items.translation: 框架子类的执行后回调，用于委托处理（针对启动/停止操作），自定义子类也可扩展此功能（确保同时调用此实现）。

items.source:
A before-execute callback for framework subclasses to delegate to
(for start/stop handling), and possibly also for custom subclasses
to extend (making sure to call this implementation as well).
items.translation: 用于框架子类委托（以处理启动/停止）的 before-execute 回调，自定义子类也可扩展此回调（确保同时调用此实现）。

items.source: Return the lifecycle phase for pausing and resuming this executor.
items.translation: 返回用于暂停和恢复此执行器的生命周期阶段。

items.source: Set up the ExecutorService.
items.translation: 配置 ExecutorService。

items.source: Check whether this executor is not paused and has not been shut down either.
items.translation: 检查该执行器是否未处于暂停状态且未被关闭。

items.source: Resume this executor if paused before (otherwise a no-op).
items.translation: 如果之前已暂停，则恢复此执行器（否则为无操作）。

items.source: Pause this executor, not waiting for tasks to complete.
items.translation: 暂停此执行器，无需等待任务完成。

items.source:
Pause this executor, triggering the given callback
once all currently executing tasks have completed.
items.translation: 暂停此执行器，在所有当前正在执行的任务完成后触发给定的回调。

items.source:
Specify the prefix to use for the names of newly created threads.
Default is "SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor-".
items.translation: 指定用于新创建线程名称的前缀。默认值为"SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor-"。

items.source:
Set the RejectedExecutionHandler to use for the ExecutorService.
The default is the ExecutorService's default abort policy.
items.translation: 设置用于 ExecutorService 的 RejectedExecutionHandler。默认值为 ExecutorService 的默认中止策略。
